label: P2 treatment effect size vs pre-treatment
provenance_note: An artifact identifies its own arm through provenance.electric_flags; this instrument reads that field rather than trusting the filename, because a flag-OFF reproduction of a run that secretly had a treatment on would prove nothing.

tolerance.basis: G0-prime noise floor: 11 rows of 3,672 moved across three identical clones, all in these two cells, because the speech-act row is gated on 2.0 s of wall clock. R13 excluded these cells from the noise-floor claim; this instrument excludes them from the inertness FAILURE and still counts them.
